name: Coinbase BTC/USD displayed best quote
description: The displayed best bid and ask from the Coinbase BTC/USD ticker input, with the exact-decimal midpoint (bid plus ask divided by two) and spread_bps as (ask minus bid) divided by midpoint times 10000. input_age_ms is the admission time minus the quote's logical receipt time. Ready output requires a positive uncrossed quote received no more than 10000 milliseconds before production. Readiness guards evaluate full internal decimal precision before rounding. This identity is single-venue: it reads only Coinbase inputs and is ready whenever the Coinbase quote is positive, uncrossed, and inside the staleness bound, independently of the other adopted spot venue. The blended `btc.external.*` reading of the same measurement stays the reference layer and continues to require every adopted venue (ADR 0024). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
